description: Volume I of the First Edition, Framework Version 1.0, of the four-volume Global Artificial Intelligence Development and Competitiveness Assessment Framework.
abstract: This volume forms part of the First Edition, Framework Version 1.0, of the Global Artificial Intelligence Development and Competitiveness Assessment Framework. It presents the conceptual foundations, algorithmic structures, platform systems, infrastructure layers, and application domains used to evaluate artificial intelligence development and competitiveness. The Framework is designed as an open, extensible, and evolving assessment architecture that may be revised as AI technologies, data conditions, governance environments, and measurement needs develop.
